s.d: ὄψώνιον, -ου, τό (ὀψον- see: ὀψάριον— and ὠνέομαι), [in LXX: I [[esther 4 56|Est.4:56]], 1Ma.3:28 1Mac 14:32 * ;] 1. provisions, provision-money, soldiers' pay: [[luke 3 14|Luk.3:14]], [[1-corinthians 9 7|1Co.9:7]]. 2. Generally, wages, hire: [[2-corinthians 11 8|2Co.11:8;]] ὄ. τῆς ἁμαρτίας, [[romans 6 23|Rom.6:23]] (see Deiss, BS, 148, 266).† (AS)

s.w: ο ων και ο ην και ο ερχομενος
s.t: o ōn kai o ēn kai o erchomenos
s.p: G:T + G:V + G:CONJ + G:T + G:V + G:CONJ + G:T + G:V
s.d: 1. as Substantive Verb, to be, to exist , οὐκ ἔσθ᾽ οὗτος ἀνήρ, οὐδ᾽ ἔσσεται (Odyssey by Homer); τεθνηῶτος, μηδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἐόντος (Odyssey by Homer); οὐκέτ᾽ ἔστι he is no more , (Euripides); θεοὶ αἰὲν ἐόντες (Iliad by Homer); ἐσσόμενοι posterity, (Iliad by Homer); ζώντων καὶ ὄντων Ἀθηναίων (Demosthenes Orator):—;so of cities, etc., ὄλωλεν, οὐδ᾽ ἔτ᾽ ἔστι Τροία (compare Troja fuit) , (Euripides) 2. of things, to be, exist , εἰ ἔστιν ἀληθέως [ ἡ τράπεζα] (Herdotus Historicus); ἕως ἂν ὁ πόλεμος ἦι so long as it last , (Thucydides) 3. to be , opposite to appearing to be , as esse to videri , τὸν ἐόντα λόγον the true story, (Herdotus Historicus); τὰ ὄντα ἀπαγγέλλειν (Thucydides); τῶι ὄντι, Lat. revera, in reality, in fact, (Plato Philosophus) 4. followed by the Relative, οὐκ ἔστιν ὅς, no one , (Iliad by Homer), etc.; εἰσὶν οἵ, Lat. sunt qui, (Thucydides), etc.; ἐστὶν ἅ some things , (Thucydides); also ἔστιν οἵ, for εἰσὶν οἵ, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—;so withrelat. Particles, ἔστιν ἔνθα, Lat. est ubi, (Xenophon Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπη, ἔσθ᾽ ὅπου, somewhere , or somehow , (Plato Philosophus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅπως in some manner , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.; ἔστιν ὅτε, ἔσθ᾽ ὅτε, sometimes , (Sophocles Tragicus), etc. 5. ἔστι impersonal, with infinitive, like πάρεστι, it is possible , (Homer), attic 6. to be , Copula connecting predicate with subject, both being in the same case, (Homer), etc. 7. sometimes εἶναι with Part. represents finite Verb, ἦν τεθνηκώς, for ἐτεθνήκει, (Aeschulus Tragicus); πεφυκός ἐστι = πέφυκε, (Aristophanes Comicus) 8. the Inf. is redundant in some phrases, ἑκὼν εἶναι (see. ἑκών II); τὸ ἐπ᾽ ἐκείνοις εἶναι quantum in illis esset , (Thucydides); τὸ σύμπαν εἶναι (Herdotus Historicus); τὸ νῦν εἶναι (Plato Philosophus), etc. (ML)

παγιδεύω (παγίς), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 28 9|1Ki.28:9]] (נָקַשׁ hith.), [[ecclesiastes 9 12|Ecc.9:12]] (יָקֹשׁ pu.)* ;] to ensnare: metaphorically, with accusative, ἐν λόγῳ, [[matthew 22 15|Mat.22:15]] (not elsewhere).† (AS)

παγίς, -ίδος, ή (πήγνυμι), [in LXX for פַּח, מוֹקֵשׁ, רֶשֶׁת, etc. ;] poët. (Aristoph., al.) and late for πάγη, a trap, snare; metaphorically (as also in cl.): [[luke 21 35|Luk.21:35]], [[romans 11 9|Rom.11:9]]" (LXX) [[1-timothy 3 7|1Ti.3:7 6:9]], [[2-timothy 2 26|2Ti.2:26]].† (AS)

πάθημα, -τος, τό (πάσχω), like πάθος, 1. that which befalls one, a suffering, affliction: pl., [[romans 8 18|Rom.8:18]], [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6-7]], [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]], [[2-timothy 3 11|2Ti.3:11]], [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10 10:32]], [[1-peter 5 9|1Pe.5:9]]; of Christ's sufferings: τὰ εἰς Χ., [[1-peter 1 11|1Pe.1:11;]] τ. Χριστσῦ, [[1-peter 5 1|1Pe.5:1;]] id. as shared by Christians, [[2-corinthians 1 5|2Co.1:5]], [[philippians 3 10|Php.3:10]], [[1-peter 4 13|1Pe.4:13]]. 2. a passive emotion, affection, passion: [[galatians 5 24|Gal.5:24;]] τ. ἀμαρτιῶν, [[romans 7 5|Rom.7:5]] 3. = τὸ πάσχειν, an enduring or suffering: with genitive obj., [[hebrews 2 9|Heb.2:9.]]† SYN.: see: πάθος (AS)
παθητός, -ή, -όν (πάσχω), 1. one who has suffered. 2. subject to suffering (R, mg., see M, Pr., 222) or destined to suffer (AV, R, txt.): [[acts 26 23|Act.26:23.]]† (AS)

πάθος, -ους, τό (πάιτχω), [in LXX: [[job 30 31|Job.30:31]] (אֵבֶל), [[proverbs 25 20|Pro.25:20]], and very frequently in (4Ma.1:1 n, al.)* ;] like πάθημα; 1. that which befalls one, that which one suffers 2. a passive emotion or affection (esp. of violent emotion), a passion, passionate desire; in NT always in bad sense: [[colossians 3 5|Col.3:5;]] π. ἀτιμίας, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26;]] π. ἐπιθυμίας, [[1-thessalonians 4 5|1Th.4:5.]]† SYN.: π. = πάθημα, exc. that πάθημα is the more concrete and particular. In NT usage, π. represents the passive, ungoverned aspect of evil desire, as opposite to ἐπιθυμία, which is the active and also the more comprehensive term (see Tr., Syn., LXXxvii); cf. also ὄρεξις (AS)

παιδαγωγός, -oῦ, ὁ (παῖς, ἄγω), a guide, guardian, trainer of boys, a tutor (disting. from διδάσκαλος, Xen., Lac., 3, 1), usually a trusty slave: opposite to πατήρ, [[1-corinthians 4 15|1Co.4:15;]] figuratively, of the Law, π. εἰς Χριστόν, [[galatians 3 24|Gal.3:24-25.]]† (AS)

παιδάριον, -ου, τό dimin. of παῖς, [in LXX chiefly for נַעַר ;] a little boy, a lad (in late and colloq. Gk. the word seems to be used with greater latitude and even to lose its dimin. force entirely; cf. Tob.6:2-3, and see MM, xviii): [[john 6 9|Jhn.6:9.]]† SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

παιδεία (-ία, Τ), -ας, ἡ (παιδεύω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּסָר ;] 1. the rearing of a child (Æsch.). 2. training, learning, instruction (Plat., al.): [[ephesians 6 4|Eph.6:4]], [[2-timothy 3 16|2Ti.3:16]]. 3. As in LXX ([[proverbs 3 11|Pro.3:11 15:5]], al.), chasten­ing, discipline: [[hebrews 12 5|Heb.12:5]] (LXX), [[hebrews 12 7|Heb.12:7-8, 11]].† (AS)

παιδευτής, -οῦ, ὁ (παιδεύω), [in LXX: [[hosea 5 2|Hos.5:2]] (מוּסָר), Sir.37:19, 4Ma.5:34 4Mac 9:6 * ;] 1. prop., a teacher, instructor: [[romans 2 20|Rom.2:20.]] 2. a corrector, one who disciplines (cf. Ho, l.with) : [[hebrews 12 9|Heb.12:9.]]† (AS)

παιδεύω (παίς), [in LXX chiefly for יָסַר ;] 1. as in cl., to train children, hence, generally, to teach, instruct: [[acts 7 22|Act.7:22 22:3]], [[1-timothy 1 20|1Ti.1:20]], [[titus 2 12|Tit.2:12]]. 2. As in LXX ([[psalms 6 2|Psa.6:2]], [[proverbs 19 18|Pro.19:18]], Wis.3:5, al., and for prob. ex. from π., see MM, xviii), to chasten, correct, chastise: [[luke 23 16|Luk.23:16, 22]], [[2-timothy 2 25|2Ti.2:25]], [[hebrews 12 7|Heb.12:7, 10]]; of divine chastening, [[1-corinthians 11 32|1Co.11:32]], [[2-corinthians 6 9|2Co.6:9]], [[hebrews 12 6|Heb.12:6]], [[revelation 3 19|Rev.3:19]].† SYN.: διδάσκω, q.v (AS)
παιδιόθεν (παιδίον), adv., [in LXX: [[genesis 47 3|Gen.47:3]] * ;] = cl. ἐκ παιδός, παιδίον, from childhood: [[mark 9 21|Mrk.9:21.]]† (AS)

παιδίον, -ου, τό dimin, of παῖς, [in LXX chiefly for יֶלֶד, also for נַעַר, בֵּן, etc., frequently in To in ref. to full-grown youth ;] a young child, a little one: [[matthew 2 8|Mat.2:8-9, 11]], ff., [[luke 1 59|Luk.1:59, 66 1:76, 80 2:17, 27 2:40]], [[john 16 21|Jhn.16:21]], [[hebrews 11 23|Heb.11:23]]; of older children, [[matthew 18 2|Mat.18:2, 4-5]], [[mark 5 39|Mrk.5:39-41 7:30 9:24, 36]], [[luke 9 47|Luk.9:47-48 18:17]], [[john 4 49|Jhn.4:49]]; in pl., [[matthew 11 16|Mat.11:16 14:21 15:38 18:3 19:13-14]], [[mark 7 28|Mrk.7:28 10:13]] ff., [[luke 7 32|Luk.7:32 11:7 18:16]], [[hebrews 2 13|Heb.2:13-14]] Metaphorical, [[1-corinthians 14 20|1Co.14:20.]] Colloq. in familiar address (as Eng. colloq., "lads "-see M, Pr., 170n and Irish use of "boys"): [[john 21 5|Jhn.21:5]], [[1-john 2 13|1Jn.2:13]] [[john 2 18|Jn 2:18]] [[john 3 7|Jn 3:7]] † SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

παιδίσκη, -ης, ἡ dimin, of παῖς, [in LXX for שִׁפְחָה, אָמָה, etc. ;] 1. a young girl, a maiden (נַעֲרָה, [[ruth 4 12|Rut.4:12]]). 2. Colloq., a young female slave, a maid-servant (see Kennedy, Sources, 40 f.; Deiss., LAE, 186, 332.2): [[matthew 26 69|Mat.26:69]], [[mark 14 66|Mrk.14:66, 69]], [[luke 12 45|Luk.12:45 22:56]], [[john 18 17|Jhn.18:17]], [[acts 12 13|Act.12:13 16:16]]; of Hagar, [[galatians 4 22|Gal.4:22-23, 30]]" (LXX) ; id., metaphorically, [[galatians 4 31|Gal.4:31.]]† SYN.: see: παῖς (AS)

παίζω (παῖς), [in LXX: [[genesis 21 9|Gen.21:9 26:8]], [[exodus 32 6|Exo.32:6]] (צָחַק pi.); and more frequently ([[judges 16 25|Jdg.16:25]], al.) for (שָׂחַק pi. ;] prop., to play as a child, hence, generally, to play (as with singing and dancing) : [[1-corinthians 10 7|1Co.10:7]] (LXX) (cf. ἐμ-παίζω).† (AS)

παῖς, genitive, παιδός, ὁ, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for עֶבֶד, also for נַעַר, נַעֲרָה, etc. ;] 1. a child, boy, youth, maiden: ὁ π., [[matthew 17 18|Mat.17:18]], [[luke 2 43|Luk.2:43 9:42]], [[acts 20 12|Act.20:12]]; ἡ π. [[luke 8 51|Luk.8:51, 54]] (on the artic. fern, of address, see M, Pr., 70 f., 235; B1., § 33, 4); pl., [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16 21:15]]; of parentage, with genitive, [[john 4 51|Jhn.4:51]] 2. Like Heb. עֶבֶד, Lat. Auer, Fr. garcon, Eng. boy (Æsch., Aristoph., Xen., al.), servant, slave, attendant: [[matthew 8 6|Mat.8:6, 8 8:13]] [[luke 7 7|Luk.7:7 12:45 15:26]]; in late writers (Diod., LXX: [[genesis 41 37|Gen.41:37]], al.), of a king's attendant or minister : [[matthew 14 2|Mat.14:2;]] so (= Heb. יְהוָֹה עֶבֶד) π. τ. θεοῦ ([[psalms 69 18|Psa.69:18]], [[isaiah 41 8|Isa.41:8]], Wis.2:13, al.), of Israel, [[luke 1 54|Luk.1:54;]] of David, [[luke 1 69|Luk.1:69]], [[acts 4 25|Act.4:25]]; of Jesus (but see Dalman, Words, 277 f.), [[matthew 12 18|Mat.12:18]] (LXX), [[acts 3 13|Act.3:13, 26 4:27, 30]].† SYN.: 1. τέκνον, child, with emphasis on parentage and the consequent community of nature; υἱός, son, with emphasis on the privileged position of heirship; π. refers both to age and parentage, but with emphasis on the former. Cf. also (παιδάριον), (παιδίον), (παιδίσκη), and see Westc. on [[1-john 3 1|1Jn.3:1.]] 2. see: θεράπων, and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 7 f (AS)

παίω [in LXX chiefly for נָכָה hi. ;] to strike, smite: with the hand or fist, [[matthew 26 68|Mat.26:68]], [[luke 22 64|Luk.22:64]]; with a sword, [[mark 14 47|Mrk.14:47]], [[john 18 10|Jhn.18:10]]; of a reptile, to sting: [[revelation 9 5|Rev.9:5.]]† (AS)
Πακατιανή, -ῆς, ἡ Pacatiana, the Western part of the Province of Phrygia, as constituted in 4/A.D.: 1Ti subscr. (Rec.).† (AS)

πάλαι adv. of time, [in LXX: [[isaiah 48 5|Isa.48:5]], 7 (אָז), etc. ;] long ago, of old, in time past (denoting past time absolutely, as πρότερον relatively) : [[matthew 11 21|Mat.11:21]], [[luke 10 13|Luk.10:13]], [[hebrews 1 1|Heb.1:1]], Ju 4; as adj., with art., [[2-peter 1 9|2Pe.1:9;]] of time just past, [[mark 6 47|Mrk.6:47]] (WH, mg.), [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with durst. praes. (RV, all this time), [[2-corinthians 12 19|2Co.12:19.]]† (AS)

παλαιός, -ά, -όν (πάλαι), [in LXX: [[leviticus 25 22|Lev.25:22 26:10]], [[song-of-solomon 7 13|Sng.7:13]] (14) (יָשֵׁן), יָשֵׁן), [[joshua 9 4|Jos.9:4-5]], [[jeremiah 38 11|Jer.38:11]] (בָּלֶה), etc. ;] old, ancient; opposite to νέος, καινός: οἶνος, [[luke 5 3|Luk.5:3;]] διαθήκη, [[2-corinthians 3 14|2Co.3:14;]] ἐντολή, [[1-john 2 7|1Jn.2:7;]] ζύμη, [[1-corinthians 5 7|1Co.5:7-8;]] ὁ π. ἄςθρωπος (for similar phrases, see Westc., Eph., 68), [[romans 6 6|Rom.6:6]], [[ephesians 4 22|Eph.4:22]], [[colossians 3 9|Col.3:9]]; neut. pl., καινὰ καὶ π., [[matthew 13 52|Mat.13:52;]] of things not merely old, but worn by use (as Jo, l.with, LXX), [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16-17]], [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21-22]], [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36-37]].† SYN.: see: ἀρχαῖος (AS)
παλαιότης, -ητος, ἡ (παλαιός), oldness: γράμματος, [[romans 7 6|Rom.7:6.]]† (AS)

παλαιόω, -ῶ (παλαιός), [in LXX chiefly for בָּלָה, pi., in pass. for בִּי qal. ;] to make or declare old: [[hebrews 8 13|Heb.8:13;]] pass., to become old: of things worn out by time and use (cf. [[john 9 13|Jhn.9:13]], [[isaiah 50 9|Isa.50:9]], al., and see: παλαιός), [[luke 12 33|Luk.12:33]], [[hebrews 1 11|Heb.1:11]]" (LXX) ; τὸ παλαιούμενον, [[hebrews 8 13|Heb.8:13]] (where this and the act., see supr., may have the sense of abrogate, see LS, Zorell, see word).† SYN.: γηράσκω (AS)
πάλη, -ης, ἡ (πάλλω, to sway) wrestling, hence, generally, fight, contest: figuratively, of the spiritual combat of Christians, [[ephesians 6 12|Eph.6:12.]]† (AS)

παλινγενεσία (Rec. παλιγγ-), -ας, ἡ (πάλιν, γενεσις), new birth, renewal, restoration, regeneration; (a) of persons (Plut., Phil., al.), of spiritual regeneration, διὰ λουτροῦ παλινγενεστίας (genitive attr., see Ellic., in l), [[titus 3 5|Tit.3:5;]] (b) of the world, as in Stoics, Jewish Apocal., al. (see Dalman, Words, 177 ff.), [[matthew 19 28|Mat.19:28.]]† (AS)

πάλιν, adv., [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;] 1. of place, back, backwards (LS, see word). 2. Of time, again, once more: [[matthew 4 8|Mat.4:8]], [[mark 2 13|Mrk.2:13]], [[luke 23 20|Luk.23:20]], [[john 1 35|Jhn.1:35]] (and freq.), [[acts 17 32|Act.17:32]], [[romans 11 23|Rom.11:23]], [[galatians 1 9|Gal.1:9]], [[hebrews 1 6|Heb.1:6]], al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, [[acts 18 21|Act.18:21;]] ὑποστρέφειν, [[galatians 1 17|Gal.1:17;]] εἰς τὸ π., [[2-corinthians 13 2|2Co.13:2;]] π. ἐκ τρίτου (Bl., §81, 4), [[matthew 26 44|Mat.26:44;]] ἐκ δευτέρου, [[matthew 26 42|Mat.26:42]], [[acts 10 15|Act.10:15]]; π. δεῦτερον, [[john 4 54|Jhn.4:54 21:16]]; π. ἄνωθεν ( Wis.19:6), [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9]]. 3. Rhetorically, again; (a) further, moreover: [[matthew 5 33|Mat.5:33]], [[luke 13 20|Luk.13:20]], [[john 12 39|Jhn.12:39]], al.; (b) in turn, on the other hand (Soph.; LXX: Wis.13:8 16:23, al.): [[luke 6 43|Luk.6:43]], [[1-corinthians 12 21|1Co.12:21]], [[2-corinthians 10 7|2Co.10:7]], [[1-john 2 8|1Jn.2:8]]. (AS)
πανπληθεί (Rec. παμπλ-, see WH, App., 150), adv. (πᾶς, πλῆθος), = cl. παμπληθές, with the whole multitude, all together: [[luke 23 18|Luk.23:18.]]† (AS)
πάμπολυς, -πόλλη, -τολυ (πᾶς, πολύς), [in Sm.: [[job 36 31|Job.36:31]], [[psalms 40 6|Psa.40:6 89:51]] * ;] very much, very great: [[mark 8 1|Mrk.8:1]], Rec. (RV, Edd., πάλιν πολλοῦ).† (AS)
Παμφυλία, -ας, ἡ Pamphylia, a province of Asia Minor: [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10 13:13 14:24 15:38 27:5]].† (AS)
παν-δοχεῖον (-δοκίον, Τ), -ου, τό (πανδοχεύς), late form of Att.. πανδοκεῖον, an inn (khân, caravanserai): [[luke 10 34|Luk.10:34.]]† (AS)
παν-δοχεύς, -έως, ὁ (πᾶς, δέχομαι), late form of the Att.. πανδοκεύς (T, in l), an innkeeper, host: [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35.]]† (AS)

πανήγυρις, -εως, ἡ (πᾶς + ἄγυρας = ἀγορά), [in LXX: [[hosea 2 11|Hos.2:11]](13) 9:5, [[ezekiel 46 11|Eze.46:11]] (מוֹעֵד), [[amos 5 21|Amo.5:21]] (עֲצָרָה) * ;] prop., a national festal assembly in honour of a god; hence, generally, any festal assembly: [[hebrews 12 23|Heb.12:23]] (for exx. in π., see MM, xviii).† SYN.: ἐκκλησία (which see), συναγωγή (AS)

πανοικεί (Rec., LTr., -κί), adv. (πᾶς, οἶκος), a word rejected by strict Atticists, though found once in Plat. (Eryx., 392c); [in LXX: [[exodus 1 1|Exo.1:1]] (בַּיִת), 3Ma.3:27 (where A in each case reads -κίᾳ, the Attic form, cf. [[genesis 50 8|Gen.50:8]], al.)* ;] with all the household: [[acts 16 34|Act.16:34.]]† (AS)

πανοπλία, -ας, ἡ (πᾶς, ὅπλον) [in LXX: [[2-samuel 2 21|2Ki.2:21]] (חֲלִיצָה), [[job 39 20|Job.39:20]], Jdth.14:3, Wis.5:17, Sir.46:6, 1-2; 4Mac.6* ;] full armour: [[luke 11 22|Luk.11:22;]] metaphorically (cf. Wis, l.with), τ. θεοῦ, [[ephesians 6 11|Eph.6:11, 13]] † (AS)

πανουργία, -ας, ἡ (πανοῦργος), [in LXX: [[joshua 9 4|Jos.9:4]], [[proverbs 1 4|Pro.1:4 8:5]] (עׇרְמָה), [[numbers 24 22|Num.24:22]], Sir.19:25 21:22 31:10 (Sir.34:10) (in all cases in good or indifferent sense)* ;] cleverness, in cl. nearly always in bad sense, craftiness, cunning, knavery: [[luke 20 23|Luk.20:23]], [[1-corinthians 3 19|1Co.3:19]] (LXX, φρόνησις, for עׇרְמָה) [[2-corinthians 4 2|2Co.4:2 11:3]], [[ephesians 4 14|Eph.4:14]].† (AS)

πανοῦργος, -ον [in LXX chiefly for עָרוּם ;] ready to do anything; (a) in cl., chiefly in bad sense, knavish, crafty: [[2-corinthians 12 16|2Co.12:16;]] (b) in good sense, skilful, clever ([[proverbs 13 1|Pro.13:1 28:2]]).† (AS)
πανταχόθεν adv., [in LXX: 4Ma.13:1 4Mac 15:32 * ;] from all sides: [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], Rec.† (AS)

πανταχοῦ adv., [in LXX: [[isaiah 42 22|Isa.42:22]] (כָּלַם)* ;] everywhere: [[mark 1 28|Mrk.1:28 16:20]], [[luke 9 6|Luk.9:6]], [[acts 17 30|Act.17:30 24:3 28:22]], [[1-corinthians 4 17|1Co.4:17]].† (AS)

παντελής, -ές (πᾶς, τέλος), [in LXX: 3Ma.7:16 A* ;] all-complete, entire, perfect; εἰς τ. παντελές, completely, utterly: [[luke 13 11|Luk.13:11]], [[hebrews 7 25|Heb.7:25]] (where perhaps in temp. sense, finally; see MM, xviii).† (AS)
πάντῃ (Rec. -τη), adv. (πᾶς), [in LXX: Sir.50:22, 3Ma.4:1 * ;] every way, entirely: [[acts 24 3|Act.24:3.]]† (AS)
πάντοθεν adv. (πᾶς), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 48 31|Jer.48:31]] (כֹּל), al. ;] from all sides: [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45]], [[luke 19 43|Luk.19:43]], [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]].† (AS)

παντοκράτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (πᾶς, κρατέω), [in LXX: frequently in [[job 5 8|Job.5:8, 17]], al. (שַׁדַּי), and for צָבָא, in the phrase θεός (κυρίος) π., [[2-samuel 5 10|2Ki.5:10]], al., and frequently in Am, Za, Ma; also in Wis.7:25, Sir.42:17 50:14, 17 and frequently in Jth 2, 3Mac ;] almighty: [[2-corinthians 6 18|2Co.6:18]], [[revelation 1 8|Rev.1:8 4:8 11:17 15:3 16:7, 14 9:6, 15 21:22]].† (AS)

πάντοτε adv. of time (πᾶς), [in LXX: Wis.11:21 19:18 * ;] in late writers (once in Arist.) for διαπαντός, ἑκάστοτε, at all times, always: [[matthew 26 11|Mat.26:11]], [[mark 14 7|Mrk.14:7]], [[luke 15 31|Luk.15:31]], [[john 6 34|Jhn.6:34]], [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]], and frequently in Paul. Epp (AS)

πάντως adv. (πάς), [in LXX: [[2-kings 5 11|4Ki.5:11]] (see Thackeray, Gr., 47), Tob.14:8, al. ;] altogether, by all means; (a) without neg. (from Hdt. on) : [[1-corinthians 16 12|1Co.16:12;]] esp. in strong affirmations, surely, at all events: [[luke 4 23|Luk.4:23]], [[acts 21 22|Act.21:22 28:4]], [[1-corinthians 9 10|1Co.9:10]]; (b) with neg. (so always in mom.), in a complete negation: [[romans 3 9|Rom.3:9;]] in a partial negation (Bl., § 75, 7), [[1-corinthians 5 10|1Co.5:10.]]† (AS)

παρά, prep. with genitive, dative, accusative, with radical sense, beside. I. C. genitive of person(s), from the side of, from beside, from, indicating source or origin, [in LXX for מֵאֵצֶל ,מִיַד ,מִלִּפְנֵי ;] after verbs of motion, [[mark 14 43|Mrk.14:43]], [[luke 8 49|Luk.8:49]], [[john 15 26|Jhn.15:26]], al.; after verbs of seeking, receiving, hearing, etc., [[mark 8 11|Mrk.8:11 12:2]], [[john 4 9|Jhn.4:9, 52 10:18]], [[philippians 4 18|Php.4:18]], [[2-timothy 1 18|2Ti.1:18]], [[james 1 7|Jas.1:7]], al.; after passive verbs, of the agent (like ὑπό), [[matthew 21 42|Mat.21:42]], [[mark 12 11|Mrk.12:11]], [[luke 1 37|Luk.1:37]]; absol., οἱ παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ, his family, his kinsfolk, [[mark 3 21|Mrk.3:21]] (cf. M, Pr., 106f.; Field, Notes, 25f.; Swete, in l.); τὰ παρ᾽ αὐτῆς (αὐτῶν, ὑμῶν, one's means, wealth, [[mark 5 26|Mrk.5:26]], [[luke 10 7|Luk.10:7]], [[philippians 4 18|Php.4:18]]. II. C. dative of person(s) (exc. [[john 19 25|Jhn.19:25]], π. τ. σταυρῷ), by the side of, beside, by, with, [in LXX for בְּעֵינֵי ,בְּיַד ,אֵצֶל ;] [[luke 11 37|Luk.11:37 19:7]], [[john 1 40|Jhn.1:40 4:40]], [[acts 28 14|Act.28:14]], al.; παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ, at home, [[1-corinthians 16 2|1Co.16:2;]] with dative pl., among, [[matthew 22 25|Mat.22:25]], [[colossians 4 16|Col.4:16]], al.; metaphorically, [[matthew 19 26|Mat.19:26]], [[mark 10 27|Mrk.10:27]], [[luke 1 30|Luk.1:30]], [[romans 2 13|Rom.2:13]], [[james 1 27|Jas.1:27]], al. III. C. accusative, of motion by or towards, [in LXX for בְּעֵבֶר ,עַל יַד ,אֵצֶל ;] 1. of place, by the side of, beside, by, along: [[acts 10 32|Act.10:32]], [[hebrews 11 12|Heb.11:12]]; after verbs of motion, [[matthew 4 18|Mat.4:18]], [[mark 4 4|Mrk.4:4]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5]], [[acts 4 35|Act.4:35]], al.; after verbs of rest, [[matthew 13 1|Mat.13:1]], [[mark 5 21|Mrk.5:21]], [[luke 8 35|Luk.8:35]], al. 2. beside, beyond, metaphorically; (a) beyond, against, contrary to: [[acts 18 13|Act.18:13]], [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26 4:18 11:24]], al.; except, [[2-corinthians 11 24|2Co.11:24;]] (b) beyond, above, in comparison with: [[luke 3 13|Luk.3:13]], [[romans 12 3|Rom.12:3 14:5]], [[hebrews 1 4|Heb.1:4, 9 3:3]], al.; (with) on account of: [[1-corinthians 12 15|1Co.12:15, 16]]. IV. In composition: beside, to (παραλαμβάνω, παράγω), at hand (πάρειμι), from (παραρρέω), amiss (παρακούω), past (παρέρχομαι), compared with (παρομοιάζω), above measure (παροργίζω). (AS)

παρα-βαίνω [in LXX for סוּר, עָבַר, פָּרַר, שָׂטָה, etc. ;] 1. in Hom. (twice), to go by the side of, stand beside. 2. In Æsch., Herod., Thuc., al., to go past or pass over, chiefly metaphorically, to overstep, violate, transgress ([[joshua 7 11|Jos.7:11]], [[ezekiel 16 59|Eze.16:59]], Sir.40:14, al.) : τ. παράδοσιν, [[matthew 15 2|Mat.15:2;]] τ. ἐντολήν, [[matthew 15 3|Mat.15:3;]] before ἀπό (as מִן סוּר, [[deuteronomy 17 20|Deu.17:20]], al.), to turn aside, fall away (cf. π. τῆς ἀληθείας, Arist., Cael., i, 5, 2): [[acts 1 25|Act.1:25.]]† (AS)

παρα-βάλλω [in LXX: [[proverbs 2 2|Pro.2:2 4:20 5:1, 13 22:17]] (נָטָה hi.), [[ruth 2 16|Rut.2:16]] (שָׁלַל), 2Ma.14:38 (elsewhere as seel.4)* ;] 1. to throw to or beside, as fodder to horses (Hom., al.). 2. to lay beside, compare (Hdt., Plat., al.): [[mark 4 30|Mrk.4:30]], Rec. 3. Reflexive, to betake oneself, come near; of seamen, to cross over: εἰς Σάμον, [[acts 20 15|Act.20:15.]] 4. In mid. = παραβολεύομαι, which see† (AS)

παρά-βασις, -εως, ἡ (παραβαίνω), [in LXX: [[psalms 101 3|Psa.101:3]] (שֵׂט), [[2-kings 2 24|4Ki.2:24]] A, Wis.14:31, 2Ma.15:10 * ;] 1. a going aside, a deviation (Arist.). 2. In later writers, an overstepping; metaphorically, transgression (Plut., al.) : [[romans 4 15|Rom.4:15 5:14]], [[hebrews 2 2|Heb.2:2 9:15]]; τ. νόμου, [[romans 2 23|Rom.2:23;]] ἐν π., [[1-timothy 2 14|1Ti.2:14;]] τ. παραβάσεων χάριν, [[galatians 3 19|Gal.3:19]] SYN.: see: ἁμαρτία (AS)

παρα-βάτης, -ου, ὁ (παραβαίνω), [in Sm.: [[psalms 17 4|Psa.17:4 139:19]], [[jeremiah 6 28|Jer.6:28]] * ;] 1. one who stands beside, the warrior who stands by the charioteer (of. παραβαίνω, 1). 2. a transgressor (Æsch., παρβάτης): [[galatians 2 18|Gal.2:18]], [[james 2 9|Jas.2:9]]; π. νόμου, [[romans 2 25|Rom.2:25, 27]], [[james 2 11|Jas.2:11]].† (AS)

παρα-βιάζομαι [in LXX: [[genesis 19 9|Gen.19:9]], [[2-kings 2 17|4Ki.2:17]] (פָּצַר), [[deuteronomy 1 43|Deu.1:43]] (זוּד hi.), [[1-samuel 28 23|1Ki.28:23]] (פָּרַץ) see1. 4 * ;] 1. prop., to force against nature or law. 2. to compel by force (Polyb.). 3. to constrain by entreaty (Ge, 1Sam, ll. with): [[luke 24 29|Luk.24:29]], [[acts 16 15|Act.16:15]].† (AS)

παραβολή, -ῆς, ἡ (παραβάλλω), [in LXX (cf. McNeile, Mt., 185): [[numbers 23 7|Num.23:7]], [[deuteronomy 28 37|Deu.28:37]], [[psalms 44 14|Psa.44:14]], [[proverbs 1 6|Pro.1:6]], [[ezekiel 12 22|Eze.12:22]], al. (מָשַׁל), Sir.47:17 (חִידָה), al. mutt. in Sir, Wis.5:3 ;] 1. a placing beside, juxtaposition (Polyb., al.). 2. a comparing, comparison (Plat., Arist., al.). 3. a comparison, illustration, analogy, figure (Arist., al.) : [[matthew 24 32|Mat.24:32]], [[mark 3 23|Mrk.3:23]], [[hebrews 9 9|Heb.9:9 11:19]]; specif. of the pictures and narratives drawn from nature and human life which are characteristic of the synoptic teaching of our Lord, a parable: [[matthew 13 3|Mat.13:3, 10]] [[mark 4 2|Mrk.4:2, 10]], [[luke 8 4|Luk.8:4, 9-11]], al.; with genitive ref., [[matthew 13 18|Mat.13:18, 36]] 4 4 Like Heb. מָשַׁל ([[1-kings 10 12|1Ki.10:12]], [[proverbs 1 6|Pro.1:6]], Sir.3:29, al.), = παροιμία, a proverb or gnomic saying: [[luke 4 23|Luk.4:23 5:36 6:39]] SYN.: παροιμία (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.) (AS)

παρα-βολεύομαι = cl. παραβάλλομαι (2Ma.14:38), to expose oneself to danger, hazard one's life: with dative ref., τ. ψυχῇ (see M, Pr., 64), [[philippians 2 30|Php.2:30]] (Rec. παραβουλ-). Cited by Deiss., LAE, 84, 120.† παρα-βουλεύομαι, to consult amiss, or perh. (see LS, see word), a vulg. form of παρα-βολ- (which see) : [[philippians 2 30|Php.2:30]], Rec.† (AS)

παρ-αγγελία, -ας, ἡ (παραγγέλλω), an instruction, charge, com­mand: [[acts 5 28|Act.5:28 16:24]], [[1-thessalonians 4 2|1Th.4:2]], [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5 1:18]]. (In Xen., Polyb., of a military order.)† (AS)

παρ-αγγέλλω (παρά, ἀγγὲλλω), [in LXX for שָׁמַע pi., hi., etc. ;] 1. to transmit a message (Æsch., Eur.). 2. to order, command (Hdt., Xen., al.) : with inf., [[acts 15 5|Act.15:5;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 11 17|1Co.11:17]], [[2-thessalonians 3 4|2Th.3:4]], [[1-timothy 4 11|1Ti.4:11 5:7]]; before ἵνα (M, Pr., 207; Bl., § 69, 4), [[mark 6 8|Mrk.6:8]], [[2-thessalonians 3 12|2Th.3:12]]; with dative of person(s), [[acts 17 30|Act.17:30]] R, txt., [[1-thessalonians 4 11|1Th.4:11;]] before λέγων, [[matthew 10 5|Mat.10:5;]] with inf. aor., [[matthew 15 35|Mat.15:35]], [[mark 8 6|Mrk.8:6]], [[luke 8 29|Luk.8:29]], [[acts 10 42|Act.10:42 16:18]] (aoristic pres.; see M, Pr., 119); id. with neg., μή, [[luke 5 14|Luk.5:14 8:56]], [[acts 23 22|Act.23:22]], [[1-corinthians 7 10|1Co.7:10]]; with inf. pres., [[acts 16 23|Act.16:23]], [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6]]; id. with neg., ιή, [[luke 9 21|Luk.9:21]], [[acts 1 4|Act.1:4 4:18 5:28, 40]], [[1-timothy 1 3|1Ti.1:3 6:17]]; with accusative, τοῦτο, before ὅτι (E1., § 70, 3), [[2-thessalonians 3 10|2Th.3:10;]] with accusative and inf., [[acts 23 30|Act.23:30]], [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6]], [[1-timothy 6 13|1Ti.6:13]] (Bl., § 72, 5).† SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

παρα-γίνομαι (Ion. and late for -γίγν-), [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;] 1. to be beside or at hand (Hom., Hdt., al.), hence, to stand by, sup­port (Æsch., Thuc., al.) : with dative of person(s), [[2-timothy 4 16|2Ti.4:16.]] 2. to come, come up, arrive (Hdt., Xen., al., and frequently in later writers; see MM, xviii; Thackeray, Gr., 267.2): absol., [[luke 14 21|Luk.14:21 19:16]], [[john 3 23|Jhn.3:23]], [[acts 5 21|Act.5:21-22, 25 9:39 10:32-33 11:23 14:27 17:10 18:27 21:18 23:16, 35 24:17, 24 25:7 28:21]], [[1-corinthians 16 3|1Co.16:3]]; before εἰς, [[john 8 2|Jhn.8:2]], [[acts 9 26|Act.9:26 15:4]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[luke 22 52|Luk.22:52;]] πρός, with accusative, [[luke 7 4|Luk.7:4, 20 8:19]], [[acts 20 18|Act.20:18]]; id. before ἐκ, [[luke 11 6|Luk.11:6;]] παρά, with genitive, [[mark 14 43|Mrk.14:43;]] ἀπὸ . . . εἰς, [[matthew 2 1|Mat.2:1]], [[acts 13 14|Act.13:14]]; ἀπὸ . . . ἐπὶ . . . πρός, [[matthew 3 13|Mat.3:13;]] of a teacher coming forward in public: [[matthew 3 1|Mat.3:1]], [[luke 12 51|Luk.12:51]], [[hebrews 9 11|Heb.9:11]].† (AS)

παρ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;] 1. trans., to lead by, lead aside, lead into, lead forward, etc. 2. Intrans., (a) to pass by: [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9, 27 20:30]], [[mark 2 14|Mrk.2:14 15:21]], [[john 8 59|Jhn.8:59]] R, txt., [[john 9 1|Jhn.9:1;]] before παρό, with accusative, [[mark 1 16|Mrk.1:16;]] (b) to go away, depart; metaphorically, to pass away: [[1-corinthians 7 31|1Co.7:31;]] mid., [[1-john 2 8|1Jn.2:8]] [[john 2 17|Jn 2:17]].† (AS)

παρα-δειγματίζω (δείκνυμι), [in LXX: [[numbers 25 4|Num.25:4]] (יָקַע hi.), [[jeremiah 13 22|Jer.13:22]] (חָמַס ni.), [[ezekiel 28 17|Eze.28:17]] (רַאֲוָה), [[esther 4 17|Est.4:17]], Dan LXX 2:5 * ;] to set forth as an example; in bad sense, to put to open shame: [[hebrews 6 6|Heb.6:6]] (Polyb., Plut., al.).† (AS)

παράδεισος, -ου, ὁ (an Oriental word, first used by Xen. of the parks of Persian kings and nobles) [in LXX chiefly for גַּן, [[genesis 1 8|Gen.1:8]] ff., al.; also for עֵדֶן, [[isaiah 51 3|Isa.51:3;]] פַּרְדֵּס, [[nehemiah 2 8|Neh.2:8]], [[ecclesiastes 2 5|Ecc.2:5]] ;] 1. a park, pleasure-ground, garden (LXX), an orchard (in π., see MM, ii, xviii; Deiss., BS, 148). 2. Paradise, the abode of the blessed dead: [[luke 23 43|Luk.23:43]], [[2-corinthians 12 4|2Co.12:4]], [[revelation 2 7|Rev.2:7]].† (AS)

παρα-δέχομαι [in LXX: [[exodus 23 1|Exo.23:1]] (נָשָׂא), [[proverbs 3 12|Pro.3:12]] (רָצָה), 2Ma.4:22 R, 3Ma.7:12 * ;] to receive, admit; (a) of things: [[mark 4 20|Mrk.4:20]], [[acts 15 4|Act.15:4 16:21 22:18]], [[1-timothy 5 19|1Ti.5:19]]; (b) of persons: [[hebrews 12 6|Heb.12:6]] (LXX).† (AS)

παρα-δια-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ useless wrangling: seel. in Rec. for διαπαρατριβή (which see), [[1-timothy 6 5|1Ti.6:5.]]† δια-παρα-τριβή, -ῆς, ἡ (παρατριβή, friction, irritation) mutual irritation (Field, Notes, 211), wrangling: [[1-timothy 6 5|1Ti.6:5]] (Rec. παραδιατριβή).† (AS)

παρα-δίδωμι, [in LXX chiefly for נתן ;] correl. to παρδέχομαι, 1. to give or hand over to another: with accusative and dative, [[matthew 11 27|Mat.11:27 25:14]], [[luke 4 6|Luk.4:6]], al.; of being delivered up to a course of teaching, pass. before εἰς, [[romans 6 17|Rom.6:17.]] 2. to commit, commend: [[acts 14 26|Act.14:26 15:40]], [[1-peter 2 23|1Pe.2:23]]. 3. to give or deliver up to prison or judgment: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 4 12|Mat.4:12]], [[mark 1 14|Mrk.1:14]], [[romans 4 25|Rom.4:25]], [[2-peter 2 4|2Pe.2:4]]; id. before ὑπέρ, [[romans 8 32|Rom.8:32;]] with dative, [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25]], [[mark 15 1|Mrk.15:1]], [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58]], [[john 19 11|Jhn.19:11]], al.; id. before ἵνα, [[john 19 16|Jhn.19:16;]] with inf., [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4;]] before εἰς, [[matthew 10 17|Mat.10:17 17:22 24:9]], [[luke 21 12|Luk.21:12]], [[acts 8 3|Act.8:3]], [[2-corinthians 4 11|2Co.4:11]], al.; τ. Σατανᾷ, [[1-timothy 1 20|1Ti.1:20;]] id. before εἰς, [[1-corinthians 5 5|1Co.5:5;]] with the collat. idea of treachery (= προδίδωμι), with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 26 25|Mat.26:25]], [[mark 14 11|Mrk.14:11]], [[john 6 64|Jhn.6:64]], al.; id. with dative, [[matthew 26 15|Mat.26:15]], al.; present ptcp., ὁ παραδιδοὺς, [[matthew 26 25|Mat.26:25]], [[mark 14 42|Mrk.14:42]], [[john 13 11|Jhn.13:11]]. 4. to hand down, hand on or deliver verbally (traditions, commands, etc.): [[mark 7 13|Mrk.7:13]], [[luke 1 2|Luk.1:2]], [[acts 6 14|Act.6:14]], [[1-corinthians 11 2|1Co.11:2 15:2]]; pass., [[2-peter 2 21|2Pe.2:21]], Ju 3. 5. to permit (for exx. in cl., see LS, see word): [[mark 4 29|Mrk.4:29.]] (AS)

παράδοξος, -ον (παρά, δόξα), [in LXX: Jdth.13:13, Wis.5:2 16:17 19:5, Sir.43:25; 2-4 Mac 3 * ;] contrary to received opinion, incredible, marvellous: pl., [[luke 5 26|Luk.5:26.]]† SYN.: see: δύναμις (AS)

παρά-δοσις, -εως, ἡ (παραδίδωμι), [in LXX: [[esther 7 26|Est.7:26]] (אֵסוּר), [[jeremiah 32 4|Jer.32:4]] (נָתַן ni.), [[jeremiah 34 2|Jer.34:2]] * ;] 1. a handing down or over, transfer, transmission (Arist., Polyb., al., LXX). 2. tradition of doctrine (Plat., Epict., al.); by meton., of the doctrine itself : [[matthew 15 2|Mat.15:2-3]], 6, [[mark 7 3|Mrk.7:3]], [[1-corinthians 11 2|1Co.11:2]], [[galatians 1 14|Gal.1:14]], [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8]], [[2-thessalonians 2 15|2Th.2:15 3:9]].† (AS)

παρα-ζηλόω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 32 21|Deu.32:21]], [[1-kings 14 22|3Ki.14:22]], [[psalms 78 58|Psa.78:58]] (קָנָא pi., hi.), [[psalms 37 1|Psa.37:1, 7-8]] (חָרָה hith.), Sir.30:3 * ;] to provoke to jealousy: [[romans 10 19|Rom.10:19]] (LXX) [[romans 11 11|Rom.11:11, 14]], [[1-corinthians 10 22|1Co.10:22]].† (AS)
παρα-θαλάσσιος, -α, -ον (παρά, θάλασσα) [in LXX: [[jeremiah 47 7|Jer.47:7]] (יָם חוֹף), etc. ;] by the sea: [[matthew 4 13|Mat.4:13.]]† (AS)
παρα-θεωρέω, -ῶ 1. to examine side by side, compare. 2. to over­look, neglect: pass., [[acts 6 1|Act.6:1.]]† (AS)

παρα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (παρατίθημι), [in LXX: [[leviticus 6 2|Lev.6:2]], 4 ([[leviticus 5 21|Lev 5:21, 23]]) (פִּקָּדוֹן), and in Tob 10:13, 2Ma.3:10 2Mac 3:15, seel. for παρακαταθήκη (which see) * ;] a deposit or trust: [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 1 12|2Ti.1:12 1:14]] (for exx. of this form, see MM, Exp., iii, xviii).† (AS)

παρ-αινέω, -ω [in LXX: 2Ma.7:25-26, 3Ma.5:17 3Mac 7:12 * ;] to exhort, advise: with accusative of person(s) and inf. (see Bl., § 72, 5; M, Pr., 205), [[acts 27 22|Act.27:22;]] absol., before λέγων, [[acts 27 9|Act.27:9.]]† (AS)

παρ-αιτέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX for בָּקַשׁ pi., etc. ;] 1. to beg of or from another: [[mark 15 6|Mrk.15:6]] (Rec. ὅνπερ ᾐτοῦντο, see Field, Notes, 43). 2. to deprecate; (a) prop., with neg., to entreat that not (Thuc., al.): [[hebrews 12 19|Heb.12:19;]] (b) to refuse, decline, avoid: o. accusative, [[1-timothy 4 7|1Ti.4:7 5:11]], [[2-timothy 2 23|2Ti.2:23]], [[titus 3 10|Tit.3:10]], [[hebrews 12 25|Heb.12:25]] (EV; but see Field, Notes, 234). 3. to beg off, ask to be excused, excuse (Polyb., al.) : [[luke 14 18|Luk.14:18-19]] ([[hebrews 12 25|Heb.12:25]], Field, l.with).† (AS)
παρα-καθίζω [in LXX: [[job 2 13|Job.2:13]] (יָשַׁב)* ;] to set beside; act. for mid., to sit down beside: [[luke 10 39|Luk.10:39]], Rec. (for -έζομαι, which see).† (AS)

παρακαλέω, -ῶ, [in LXX chiefly for נחם ni., pi. ;] 1. to call to one, call for, summon: [[acts 28 20|Act.28:20]] (R, mg.; R, txt., entreat); hence (of the gods: Dem., Xen., al.), to invoke, call on, beseech, entreat: τ. πατέρα μου, [[matthew 26 53|Mat.26:53;]] τ. κύριον, [[2-corinthians 12 8|2Co.12:8;]] in late writers (Polyb., Diod., al.; rarely in LXX; in π., see Deiss., LAE, 176.14), also of men: absol., Phm 9; with accusative, [[matthew 8 5|Mat.8:5]], [[mark 1 40|Mrk.1:40]], [[acts 16 9|Act.16:9]], al.; with inf., [[mark 5 17|Mrk.5:17]], [[luke 8 41|Luk.8:41]], [[acts 8 31|Act.8:31]], al.; before ἵνα (see M, Pr., 205, 208), Mt 14"36, [[mark 5 18|Mrk.5:18]], Luk.8:31, al. 2. to admonish, exhort: absol., [[luke 3 18|Luk.3:18]], [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8]], [[2-timothy 4 2|2Ti.4:2]], al.; with accusative, [[acts 15 32|Act.15:32]], [[1-thessalonians 2 11|1Th.2:11]], [[hebrews 3 13|Heb.3:13]], al.; id. before inf., [[acts 11 23|Act.11:23]], [[romans 12 1|Rom.12:1]], [[philippians 4 2|Php.4:2]], [[1-thessalonians 4 10|1Th.4:10]], al.; before ἵνα (see M, Pr., l.with), [[1-corinthians 1 10|1Co.1:10]], [[2-corinthians 8 6|2Co.8:6]], [[1-thessalonians 4 1|1Th.4:1]], al. 3. to cheer, encourage, comfort (Plut., LXX: Jb 43, [[isaiah 35 3|Isa.35:3]], Sir.43:24, al.): with accusative, [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6]], [[ephesians 6 22|Eph.6:22]], [[colossians 2 2|Col.2:2]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[1-thessalonians 4 18|1Th.4:18;]] διά, [[2-corinthians 1 4|2Co.1:4;]] pass., [[matthew 5 4|Mat.5:4]], [[luke 16 25|Luk.16:25]], [[acts 20 12|Act.20:12]]. SYN.: παραμυθέω (cf. M, Th., 25). (AS)

παρα-καλύπτω [in LXX: [[isaiah 44 8|Isa.44:8]] (פָּחַד), [[ezekiel 22 26|Eze.22:26]] (עָלַם hi.)* ;] to cover by hanging something beside, to hide: metaphorically (as Plat., al.), [[luke 9 45|Luk.9:45.]]† (AS)

παρα-κατα-θήκη, -ης, ἡ (παρακατατίθημι) [in LXX: [[exodus 22 8|Exo.22:8, 11]] (מְלָאכָה), and elsewhere as seel. for παραθήκη, which see ;] more usual than its variant in Gk. writers for a trust or deposit: [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]], [[2-timothy 1 14|2Ti.1:14]], Rec.† (AS)
παρά-κειμαι [in LXX: Jdt.3.2-3, Sir.30:18 34:16, Dan LXX Bel 1:14, 2,3 Mac.5* ;] to lie beside, be near, be present: [[romans 7 18|Rom.7:18, 21]].† (AS)

παρά-κλησις, -εως, ἡ (παρακαλέω), [in LXX : [[job 21 2|Job.21:2]], [[psalms 94 19|Psa.94:19]], [[hosea 13 14|Hos.13:14]], [[nahum 3 7|Nam.3:7]], [[isaiah 57 18|Isa.57:18 66:11]], [[jeremiah 16 7|Jer.16:7]] (נָחַם, its parts and derivatives), [[jeremiah 38 9|Jer.38:9]] (תַּחֲנוּן), [[isaiah 28 29|Isa.28:29 30:7]], 1Ma.10:24 1Mac 12:9, 2Ma.7:24 2Mac 15:11 * ;] 1. a calling to one's aid, summons (Thus.), hence, appeal, entreaty (Strab., Plut., al., 1Ma.10:24; of. Lft., Notes, 20) : [[2-corinthians 8 4|2Co.8:4.]] 2. exhortation, encouragement: [[acts 15 31|Act.15:31]], [[romans 12 8|Rom.12:8]], [[1-corinthians 14 3|1Co.14:3]], [[2-corinthians 8 17|2Co.8:17]], [[philippians 2 1|Php.2:1]], [[1-thessalonians 2 3|1Th.2:3]], [[1-timothy 4 13|1Ti.4:13]], [[hebrews 12 5|Heb.12:5]]; λόγος (τῆς) π., [[acts 13 15|Act.13:15]], [[hebrews 13 22|Heb.13:22]]; υἱὸς π., [[acts 4 36|Act.4:36.]] 3. consolation, comfort (Phalar., LXX) : [[luke 6 24|Luk.6:24]], [[acts 9 31|Act.9:31]], [[2-corinthians 1 4|2Co.1:4-7 7:4 7:7 7:13]], [[2-thessalonians 2 16|2Th.2:16]], Phm 7; τ. γραφῶν, [[romans 15 4|Rom.15:4;]] θεὸς τῆς π., [[romans 15 5|Rom.15:5]], [[2-corinthians 1 3|2Co.1:3]]; π. τοῦ Ἰσραήλ (see Dalman, Words, 109 f.), Lk (AS)

παρά-κλητος, -ον (παρακαλεω), [in Aq., Th.: [[job 16 2|Job.16:2]] * ;] called to one's aid in a judicial cause (Dion. Cass.); hence, most frequently as subst., ὁ π., an advocate, pleader, intercessor (Dem., al.; so in Rabbinic lit., פְּרַקְלִיטָא), "a friend of the accused person, called to speak to his character, or otherwise enlist sympathy in his favour" (Field, Notes, 102). In NT, specif., ὁ π., (a) of Christ, [[1-john 2 1|1Jn.2:1]] (see ICC, Jo. Epp., 23 ff.); (b) of the Holy Spirit (AV, comforter; but see opp. with), [[john 14 16|Jhn.14:16, 26 15:26 16:7]] (cf. also Abbott, Essays, 86, 97; Deiss., LAE, 339 f.; MM, xviii; Westc., Jo., ii, 188) (AS)

παρ-ακοή, -ῆς, ἡ 1. a hearing amiss (Flat.) 2. Later, as following inattention, disobedience: [[romans 5 19|Rom.5:19]], [[2-corinthians 10 6|2Co.10:6]], [[hebrews 2 2|Heb.2:2]] (cf. παρακούω, and see Tr., Syn., § lxvi).† (AS)

παρ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 2Mac 9:27 R* ;] with dative, to follow closely, accompany. Metaphorical, in various senses, (a) to result: [[mark 16 17|Mrk.16:17;]] (b) to follow up, trace, investigate: [[luke 1 3|Luk.1:3]] (so frequently in cl.); (with) to follow as a standard of conduct: [[1-timothy 4 6|1Ti.4:6]], [[2-timothy 3 10|2Ti.3:10]]. (For exx. from π., see MM, xviii.)† (AS)

παρ-ακούω [in LXX: [[esther 3 3|Est.3:3]], 8 (עָבַר, עָשָׂה, with neg.) [[esther 4 14|Est.4:14 7:4]] (חָרַשׁ hi.), [[isaiah 65 12|Isa.65:12]] (שָׁמַע, with neg.), I [[esther 4 11|Est.4:11]], Tob.3:4 * ;] 1. to overhear. 2. to hear amiss or imperfectly. 3. Later (as in LXX, Polyb., Plut.; also in π., see MM, xviii), to hear without heeding, take no heed: [[mark 5 36|Mrk.5:36;]] with genitive, [[matthew 18 17|Mat.18:17.]]† (AS)

παρα-κύπτω [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקַף ni., hi. ;] 1. to stoop sideways. 2. to stoop to look: [[luke 24 12|Luk.24:12]] (R, txt.), [[john 20 5|Jhn.20:5, 11]], Metaphorical (see Hort, Ja., in l), to look into: before εἰς, [[james 1 25|Jas.1:25]], [[1-peter 1 12|1Pe.1:12]].† (AS)

παρα-λαμβάνω [in LXX chiefly for לָקַח, also for יָרַשׁ, etc. ;] 1. with accusative of thing(s), like παραδέχομαι, correl. to παραδίδωμι, to receive from another: [[colossians 4 17|Col.4:17]], [[hebrews 12 28|Heb.12:28]]; of the mind, [[1-corinthians 11 23|1Co.11:23 15:1 15:3]], [[galatians 1 9|Gal.1:9]], [[philippians 4 9|Php.4:9]]; with inf., [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4;]] before παρά, with gem, [[galatians 1 12|Gal.1:12]], [[1-thessalonians 2 13|1Th.2:13 4:1]], [[2-thessalonians 3 6|2Th.3:6]]; τ. Χριστόν (Lft., in l), [[colossians 2 6|Col.2:6.]] 2. C. accusative of person(s), to take to or with oneself: [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13-14, 20-21 17:1 26:37]], [[mark 4 36|Mrk.4:36 5:40 9:2 10:32]], [[luke 9 10|Luk.9:10, 28 11:26 18:31 19:16]], [[acts 15 39|Act.15:39 23:18]]; γυναῖκα, [[matthew 1 20|Mat.1:20, 24]]; μεθ᾽ ἑαυτοῦ, [[matthew 12 45|Mat.12:45 18:16]], [[mark 14 33|Mrk.14:33]]; before εἰς, [[matthew 4 5|Mat.4:5, 8 27:27]]; κατ᾽ ἰδίαν, [[matthew 20 17|Mat.20:17;]] mid., before πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, [[john 14 3|Jhn.14:3;]] pass., [[matthew 24 40|Mat.24:40-41]], [[luke 17 34|Luk.17:34-36]]; ptcp., prefixed to other verbs (Bl, § 74, 2), [[acts 16 33|Act.16:33 21:24, 26 21:32]]; metaphorically, [[john 1 11|Jhn.1:11.]]† (AS)
παρα-λέγω to lay beside; mid., (a) to lie beside (Hom.); (b) later, of sailors, to sail past: with accusative, [[acts 27 8|Act.27:8, 13]].† (AS)

παρ-άλιος, -ον (in cl., chiefly -α, -ον), [in LXX for יָם, חוֹף, etc., with prep. ;] by the sea; ἡ π. (sc. χώρα, in LXX ἡ παραλία, [[deuteronomy 1 7|Deu.1:7]], [[joshua 9 1|Jos.9:1]], Jdth.1:7, al.), the sea coast: [[luke 6 17|Luk.6:17.]]† (AS)
παρ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (παραλλάσσω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 9 20|4Ki.9:20]] (שִׁגָּעוֹן)* ;] in various senses (LS, see word), change: [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17.]]† (AS)
παρα-λογίζομαι [in LXX chiefly for רָמָה pi. ;] 1. to miscalculate. 2. to reason falsely, hence, to mislead: [[colossians 2 4|Col.2:4]], [[james 1 22|Jas.1:22]].† (AS)
παρα-λυτικός, -ή, -όν (παραλύω), paralytic: [[matthew 4 24|Mat.4:24 8:6 9:2, 6]], [[mark 2 3|Mrk.2:3-5, 9-10]] [[luke 5 24|Luk.5:24]] (Rec., WH, mg.).† (AS)

παρα-λύω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 6 24|Jer.6:24]], [[jeremiah 27 43|Jer 27:43]], [[ezekiel 21 7|Eze.21:7]] (רָפָה), etc. ;] 1. to loose from the side, set free. 2. to weaken, enfeeble; pass., to be en­feebled, esp. by a paralytic stroke: [[luke 5 18|Luk.5:18, 24]], [[acts 8 7|Act.8:7 9:33]], [[hebrews 12 12|Heb.12:12]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

παρα-μένω [in LXX: [[proverbs 12 7|Pro.12:7]], Da TH [[daniel 11 17|Dan.11:17]] (עָמַד), etc. ;] to remain beside or near: [[hebrews 7 23|Heb.7:23]], [[james 1 25|Jas.1:25]]; of remaining alive, [[1-corinthians 16 6|1Co.16:6]] (WH, κατα-), [[philippians 1 25|Php.1:25]] (cf. συμ-παραμένω).† (AS)

παρα-μυθέομαι, -οῦμαι [in LXX: 2Ma.15:9 (Sm. 8)* ;] 1. to en­courage, exhort. 2. to comfort, console: with accusative of person(s), [[john 11 31|Jhn.11:31]], [[1-thessalonians 2 11|1Th.2:11 5:14]]; id. before περί, [[john 11 19|Jhn.11:19.]]† SYN.: παρακαλέω (AS)
παραμυθία, -ας, ἡ (παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]], Wis.19:12 * ;] 1. encouragement, exhortation. 2. comfort, consolation: [[1-corinthians 14 3|1Co.14:3]] .† SYN.: παράκλησις (AS)

παραμύθιον, -ου, τό (παραμυθέομαι) [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;] 1. an exhortation, persuasion, encouragement: [[philippians 2 1|Php.2:1]] (cf. Plat., Legg., vi, 773 E, al.; see Lft. and ICC, Phi., l.with). 2. assuagement, abatement, hence, consolation (Wis, l.with, and frequently in cl.).† (AS)
παρα-νομέω, ῶ [in LXX for הָלַל, etc., chiefly in Pss and 2Mac ;] to be a παράνομος, to transgress the law: [[acts 23 3|Act.23:3.]]† (AS)
παρανομία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[psalms 37 7|Psa.37:7]] (מְזִמָּה), etc. ;] law-breaking, transgression: [[2-peter 2 16|2Pe.2:16.]]† (AS)

παρα-πικραίνω [in LXX chiefly for מָרַד qal., hi., מְרִי, most frequently in Psa and Eze ;] to embitter, provoke: absol. (yet sc. τ. θεόν, cf. [[psalms 106 7|Psa.106:7]], [[ezekiel 2 5|Eze.2:5-8]], al., and with τὸν θ. added, [[psalms 5 4|Psa.5:4]], [[ezekiel 20 21|Eze.20:21]], al.), [[hebrews 3 16|Heb.3:16]] (cf. παραπικρασμός).† (AS)

παρα-πικρασμός, -οῦ, ἁ (παραπικραίνω) [in LXX: [[psalms 95 8|Psa.95:8]] (מְרִיבָה elsewhere rendered Λοιδόρησις, [[exodus 17 7|Exo.17:7;]] ἀντιλογία, [[deuteronomy 33 8|Deu.33:8]], al.; λοιδορία, [[numbers 20 24|Num.20:24]])* ;] provocation: ἐν τῷ π. (Heb. at Meribah), [[hebrews 3 8|Heb.3:8, 15]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

παρα-πίπτω [in LXX: [[ezekiel 14 13|Eze.14:13 15:8 18:24 20:27]] (מָעַל), [[ezekiel 22 4|Eze.22:4]] (אָשַׁם), [[esther 6 10|Est.6:10]] (נָפַל hi.), Wis.6:9 12:2, 2Ma.10:4 A* ;] 1. most frequently (Hdt., Thuc., al.), to fall in one's way, befall. 2. to fall into or in (before εἰς, Polyb.; with dative, 2Mac, l.with). 3. to fall away (En, Wis, ll. with; in Polyb., with genitive) : absol., [[hebrews 6 6|Heb.6:6.]] 4. to fail (λόγος, Es, l.with; cf. [[1-samuel 3 19|1Ki.3:19]]).† (AS)
παρα-πλέω to sail by or past: with accusative, [[acts 20 16|Act.20:16.]]† (AS)

παρα-πλήσιος, -α, -ον (Hdt., Plat., al.; also -ος, -ον, Thuc., Polyb.), coming near, nearly resembling. Neut. -ον, adverbially, = ίως, in a way nearly resembling: with dative, [[philippians 2 27|Php.2:27.]]† (AS)
παρα-πλησίως adv. (παραπλήσιος) [in Quint.: [[hosea 8 6|Hos.8:6]] * ;] in like manner: [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14.]]† (AS)

παρα-πορεύομαι [in LXX chiefly for עָבַר ;] 1. to go beside, accom­pany. 2. to go past, pass by: [[matthew 27 39|Mat.27:39]], [[mark 11 20|Mrk.11:20 15:29]]; before διά, with genitive, [[mark 2 23|Mrk.2:23 9:30]] (WH, mg.).† (AS)
